bounded_residual.anchor: E_base=pz0/0.8 GeV, traditional neutrino estimate; not vertex-muon truth
bounded_residual.prediction: log E_base + g(x)*log(64)*tanh(r(x)); g=sigmoid(g_head); no hard pz switch
bounded_residual.loss: unit logE MSE for all events +0.1 BCE(g, physical transfer fraction>=0.2) on valid physical labels; unconfirmed valid vertex labels kept
bounded_residual.calibration: one unit global mean log residual from original cal, applied once; report raw and calibrated, calibrated preselected

posterior.near_zero: one continuous component on fraction[0,0.1); no delta mass at zero
posterior.positive: two continuous components on fraction[0.1,1); fixed K, no component search
posterior.transforms: r=log((E_mu_vertex-m_mu)/pz0), f=a+(b-a)*sigmoid(s); per component independent Normal(r) and Normal(s), weights softmax. E_mu=m_mu+pz0*exp(r), h=E_mu*f/(1-f), E_nu=E_mu+h. This models truth-muon response rather than treating reco pz as truth
posterior.scale: sigma=0.05+4.95*sigmoid(head); both latent dimensions; scales in dimensionless transformed units
posterior.supervised_loss: joint proper density NLL on physical labels (include transform Jacobian; truth response of unconfirmed track kept), +0.25 marginal logE NLL on ALL events; unknown/nonphysical labels get only marginal energy NLL, not pseudo transfer supervision
posterior.boundary: exact f=0 or f=0.1 truth if present treated as fixed-width 1e-6 fraction interval-censored likelihood, never clipped target; E_mu<=m_mu labeled unknown and retains marginal energy loss
posterior.integration: 32-point Gauss-Hermite per component over s for marginal energy density, analytic r inverse/Jacobian at given E; fixed deterministic quadrature for CDF, quantiles and PIT; no stochastic spectrum toys
posterior.calibration: two scalars only: add b to all r means, multiply all r scales by T; fit original cal marginal energy NLL, b[-0.2,0.2],T[0.5,2], fixed L-BFGS-B starting(0,1),<=100 iterations. Preserves E_nu=E_mu+h; cal/eval still developed
posterior.point: posterior median primary (not mean-logE); report exp(E[logE]) as named diagnostic only; no eval winner selection
posterior.intervals: central68% and90% posterior quantiles; CDF(Etruth)=PIT; tail probabilities and 10 fixed probability bins reliability

prior_stress.training: unit weights; no added weighted fit
prior_stress.train_prior: pooled49167 empirical counts +0.5 pseudocount per bin
targets: nominal: original41447 unit nominal-train empirical prior +0.5/bin
flat logE: uniform density in logE on[50,6400], fixed bins; outside original train prior
lowE pressure: multiply nominal mass below200GeV by4 then normalize
prior_stress.ratio: target_bin_mass/train_bin_mass, cap[0.1,10] then normalize each event posterior; exactly same caps for all targets
prior_stress.ESS: (sum w)^2/sum w^2 per original E/pz/response/source stratum and per posterior quadrature; report clipping fraction, unsupported bins and ESS/N; ESS<0.2N => unsupported, no extrapolated pass
prior_stress.main: nominal preselected; flat and pressure sensitivity only, no eval selection; prior-shift interpretation assumes invariant p(x|E), not established for alternative flux/response
